text.content:
One part gang, one part government.

Turf: Coastview and West Wind Estates, Pacifica
Known for: Netrunners who expect the Blackwall to fall
Hangouts: Batty's Hotel

Not the 2020s posers of the same name. These Voodoo Boys came out of the Haitian workforce brought in to build Pacifica in the 2060s; when the investors left, they took control of part of the district and now act as its de facto government. In 2072 they drove off an NCPD task force.

"Voodoo Boys" is only what outsiders call them; initiates know the gang's true name. Many are netrunners who believe the AIs beyond the Blackwall will break through, and want to be on their good side when they do.

Gig hooks

  • The Voodoo Boys need a meatspace team for a job their netrunners can't do from a chair.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.26
